name: Millhaven
description: A river-mill town of granaries and cooperages, and the traditional starting point for wayfarers new to the roads.

name: Oakstead
description: A timber and weaving town spread along the eaves of an old forest.

name: Thornwick
description: A walled market town that hosts the Concord's regional customs house.

name: Greyfield
description: Rolling farmland dotted with granaries, quiet but for harvest season.

name: Duskrun
description: A dust-blown waystation where independent caravan masters trade far from Concord tariff posts.

name: Cinderhold
description: A fortified steppe outpost built around a smelting works, favored by the Free Caravans as a supply depot.

name: Redgate
description: A canyon-mouth trading post known for its whetstone quarries and its lack of anyone's law.

name: Saltmere
description: A bustling harbor city and the largest neutral trade hub on the reach, courted by both factions.

name: Tidewatch
description: A lighthouse town whose pearl divers supply luxury markets up and down the coast.

name: Farrow's Landing
description: A modest fishing port with a growing appetite for inland goods.

name: Brinewick
description: A salt-pan town where the Concord maintains a customs fleet to police coastal smuggling.

name: Ironspire
description: A vast terraced mining city built into the flank of the Ironspire massif, seat of Concord industry.

name: Copperfall
description: A smelting town beneath a waterfall of the same name, known for its fine ingot work.

name: Hollowpeak
description: A high mountain pass town, the last reliable stop before the eastern trade routes.

name: Mossport
description: A stilt-built fen town where peat cutters and resin gatherers ship their goods downriver.

name: Reedwick
description: A brewing town famous for its malted barley, hidden deep in the reed channels.

name: Blackfen
description: A remote fen outpost that answers to whichever caravan master last paid for its loyalty.
